samples.summary: Todo checklist items are all unchecked (`- [ ]`) even though the implementation they describe is already present and working in the tree (normalizeStyleClears in packages/docs/src/model/types.ts, wired into block-helpers.ts and yorkie-doc-store.ts, with passing tests). Pairing an unchecked todo with a lessons doc that narrates the fix as already landed is internally inconsistent and would mislead a reader into thinking the work is still pending.
samples.evidence: `- [ ] packages/docs/src/model/types.ts — add normalizeStyleClears(style)` etc. are all unchecked, yet `packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:277` already defines `normalizeStyleClears`, `packages/docs/src/store/block-helpers.ts:318` and `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:1878` already call it, and `packages/docs/test/model/types.test.ts` already tests it — matching exactly what the lessons.md file describes as done.
